projects.title: 840 Apartments Foundation Project
projects.shortDesc: Foundation construction for 27 residential buildings providing housing for 840 families.
projects.fullDesc: Comprehensive foundation construction project for 27 residential buildings at PK-13. Each building encompasses 200 square meters of foundation work, totaling 5,400 m² of high-precision structural foundation. The project was commissioned by the Ministry of Planning and Development and successfully implemented by BINAYA-IMMO GROUP in collaboration with GACEC. This large-scale housing initiative demonstrates our expertise in managing multi-building residential developments with stringent quality and timeline requirements.
tasks: Site preparation and excavation for 27 building foundations
Concrete pouring and curing for 5,400 m² of foundations
Quality control and structural integrity testing
Coordination with Ministry of Planning and Development
requirements: Compliance with national building codes and standards
High-strength concrete specifications for residential buildings
Safety protocols for large-scale construction site

projects.title: Al Rayyan Cafeteria & Mosque Complex
projects.client: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
projects.donor: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
projects.shortDesc: Iron ceiling installation for integrated cafeteria, mosque, and administrative complex.
projects.fullDesc: Sophisticated iron ceiling construction project for the Al Rayyan multi-purpose complex, encompassing a cafeteria, mosque, and administrative offices spanning 1,050 square meters. This project showcases our expertise in specialized metalwork and structural engineering for religious and public facilities. The iron ceiling system was designed to meet both functional requirements and aesthetic considerations, providing durable, elegant coverage for this important community space. Implemented by GACEC with precision craftsmanship and adherence to Islamic architectural principles.
tasks: Structural assessment and design for iron ceiling system
Custom fabrication of iron ceiling components
Installation of 1,050 m² iron ceiling structure
Coordination with Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
requirements: Acoustic considerations for mosque prayer areas
Fire safety and building code compliance

projects.title: Mosque Construction Projects
projects.shortDesc: Multiple mosque construction projects featuring traditional Islamic architecture.
projects.fullDesc: GACEC has successfully completed several mosque construction projects across Djibouti, showcasing our expertise in Islamic architectural design and construction. These projects include complete facilities with separate prayer areas for men and women, auxiliary annexes, and imam residences. Each mosque is built to the highest standards, incorporating traditional Islamic architectural elements while meeting modern building codes and accessibility requirements.
tasks: Separate prayer hall construction for men and women
Annexe facilities for ablution and community use
requirements: Qibla orientation precision for prayer direction
Acoustic design for call to prayer
Accessibility for worshippers of all ages
